messages:
Carla R: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing operator-driven tenant handshake using ephemeral client certs + staged regional cutover. Posting the plan for feedback.
Carla R: Proposal summary: phased by region, start with non-prod tenants, operator issues short-lived certs (1h) or accepts offline CSR, agents auto-renew and fail-open to legacy token for 14d. Fallback: regional shared endpoint.
Alice M: Concern: customers needing preserved source IP. Per-tenant peering keeps srcip but adds route/table churn and vpc-attachment costs.
Brian W: Tradeoffs noted. Recs: gate per-tenant peering to paid SLA tier; default to shared endpoint with SNAT semantics documented.
Matt K: For air-gapped installs: offline flow where customer supplies CSR and operator signs offline. TTL longer (24h) and operator-run manual rotation.
Jen S: Operator API sketch: POST /operator/tenants/:id/bootstrap -> token; POST /operator/tenants/:id/certs -> CreateEphemeral; PUT /.../renew -> Renew; DELETE -> Revoke.
Carla R: Rollout safety: observe-only mode -> 8-12 non-prod canaries -> regional ramps during night -> proxy auto-fallback for 10m on handshake spikes -> console manual rollback.
Alice M: DNS note: use 30s TTL during cutover but expect some clients to ignore. Add circuit-breaker and long-lived fallback window.
sre-bot: Draft alerts created: handshake.error_rate >1% (5m), cert_renew.failures, peer.route_throttle.
Brian W: Action: I'll model per-tenant cost delta and propose gating + pricing options by Tue.
Matt K: I'll own offline docs + agent compatibility matrix; agents must support RenewFromOperator() and fail-open.
Carla R: I'll PR operator API + migration runbook. Target: internal beta behind feature flag in ~3w.
ops-bot: Canary operator deployed: private-ephemeral-canary v0.1, current handshake success 99.6%.
Jen S: If no major objections in 24h I'll convert this to RFC follow-up and kick off PRs. :thumbsup:
